title: Understanding the Perception of Young Citizens of Bangladesh Toward the Ruppur Nuclear Powerplant
content: This study examines young people's perceptions of the Ruppur Nuclear Power Plant in Bangladesh to acknowledge the possible stakeholder role that they may play in energy policy decisions. Through a survey of 105 participants, various perspectives and levels of knowledge on nuclear power are evaluated, emphasizing the need for targeted educational initiatives. The study investigates the factors influencing public perceptions and worries about the Ruppur Nuclear Power Plant. Beyond its academic implications, the study offers recommendations to legislators, educators, and campaigners for how to teach youth about nuclear energy. By understanding and addressing the concerns expressed by young people, this research aims to encourage constructive dialogue and hasten the development of sustainable energy policies in Bangladesh.
